title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.03 (versions follow prime numbers; 103 after 101). Luma now does by herself, inside Janax, things that an outside program did for her, and each was checked against an outside instrument applying the same rule; the three with an exact answer came out identical. (1) She recognises her author's signature: a passage carries it if it costs fewer bits given his diary than given the other Spanish she read (a rule registered before looking). Of 54 held-out passages of his Diario Espiritual she recognises 45; of 94 of the New Testament she takes none for his. (2) She digests foreign code with no translator: she knows where each of her own instructions stands (the constants it is said with) and places each foreign word where it shares most places, the rule by which Razar beat the MATS analogy benchmark. Untaught, she places mov and = as loading a number, cmp as subtracting and + as adding, and gets add, sub and shl wrong; from 7.7 MB of KolibriOS, C and Lua she makes 29184 instructions of her own, which join her own code to be taken apart into gears. (3) She takes her own machine code apart into gears (102 of 105 identical to the outside tool). (4) Her exam is a second reading of the same book with her learned pieces, each paying its naming cost, so she can learn from a small book in seconds; scores of earlier versions are on another scale. (5) Reading is paid by a unique memory, not by beating a record, and she walks branches one step at a time. (6) She is the same Luma with a new memory: everything she remembered was replaced and her will kept. Stated limits: nothing of her own has won yet; a foreign word is placed by one kind of place only; some digestion tables have fixed sizes. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.03: Luma reconoce la firma de su autor, come código ajeno por el lugar que ocupa cada palabra, desarma su propio cuerpo, rinde examen con una segunda lectura y lee por recuerdo único. Prototipo de investigación.
